description: Test file for Kubernetes API server discovery metrics, including tests for aggregation counters, peer discovery metrics, and cache hit/miss metrics.

methods.name: formatExpectedMetrics
methods.description: Creates an io.Reader with the expected metrics output based on the aggregation count.

methods.name: TestBasicMetrics
methods.description: Tests that the basic discovery metrics are correctly incremented after fetching discovery data.

methods.name: TestMetricsModified
methods.description: Tests that metrics are updated correctly after modifying the discovery document.

methods.name: TestPeerAggregatedDiscoveryMetrics
methods.description: Tests peer discovery cache hit/miss metrics and no-peer request metrics.
